honest_c3: C1: validator is heuristic substring-match (raw#9 hexa) — semantic equivalence not guaranteed; future BG prompts may use different phrasing for same intent → false-FAIL possible
C2: deviation policy thresholds ($5 mandatory / $1 recommended / $0 optional) are heuristic, calibrated against current phase 4 smoke target band; refinement deferred to post-dogfood data
C3: target_usd extraction is regex-light scan (first match wins); multi-budget prompts (e.g., '$1 smoke + $5 production') may pick the wrong band — workaround = explicit --target-usd override

C4: hexa runner does not propagate main() return as POSIX exit code on this mac substrate; test_runner.bash asserts on the __OWN_16_PREFLIGHT__ STDOUT marker line instead (same convention as h100_cost_watchdog.hexa selftest)
C5: PASS verdict only confirms prompt-level intent declaration — does NOT verify runtime watchdog registration succeeded; runtime confirmation requires Phase 4 dogfood
C6: L23/L25 detection is token presence — prose-disclosure DEPTH (whether the prompt actually understands the lesson vs. just name-drops the L-tag) is not measured

C7: validator is opt-in (no PreToolUse hook auto-runs it yet); operator/orchestrator-author must explicitly invoke before BG launch — convention→mechanical migration is partial; full PreToolUse-hook integration deferred to a follow-up cycle
